notes: Cool nights give fruit that is nearly always high in acidity, with abundant fruit flavor.
New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc has asparagus, gooseberry and green flavors, with grassy, citrus and passion fruit notes.
Most New Zealand wine is made to drink young.

blurb.text: A South Pacific island country with a mostly maritime climate, best known for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc and, more recently, cool-climate Pinot Noir. Sauvignon Blanc covers about 65% of the vineyard area, followed by Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris. Wines are usually labeled by single grape.
